about_short_description.short_description: Tabby is a payments and shopping app that enables customers to make purchases and pay for them in installments.

product.name: Tabby App
product.description: A financial and shopping app for managing purchases, flexible payments, money transfers, cashback, savings offers, and account activity in one place.

product.name: Tabby Pay Later
product.description: A buy-now-pay-later service that lets consumers split eligible purchases into four interest-free payments or use extended plans of up to 12 monthly payments.

product.name: Tabby for Business
product.description: A merchant payment and growth platform offering flexible checkout payments, point-of-sale acceptance, payment links, merchant settlement, and customer acquisition tools.

product.name: Tabby Card
product.description: A Visa payment card that allows eligible customers to pay at Visa merchants and repay purchases immediately, after up to 40 days, or through installment plans.

identifier.value: Tabby Cash Account and Cash Card

product.name: Tabby Cash Account and Cash Card
product.description: A UAE spending account with a Visa Cash Card for everyday payments, local money transfers, balance management, and cashback on selected spending categories.

product.name: Tabby Stores & Deals
product.description: A shopping discovery service that helps users find participating merchants, exclusive offers and coupons, compare prices, and monitor product price drops.
